page.notes: Fragments at the left edge (fe-, es., ne, x-, etc.) belong to the neighbouring page and are left out. "itaq;" is uncertain: the scan shows a q with a mark that may be a 3. "incompelxū" is printed so and is kept as printed. The tables are stacked, not side by side; the side labels "Ordo ascensionis…" and "Ordo descensionis…" are printed vertically beside the first table and "Ordo ascendens/descendens" beside the second.
